description: Zola framework layer: index Tera template, home content bundle, and a SASS entry file — three files that complete a bootable Zola site when composed with the zola-static family.

buildHints.whenToUse: Static blogs, documentation sites, marketing pages, or any project that needs a zero-JS build pipeline, built-in SASS compilation, and Tera templating without a Node.js dependency.
firstSteps: Install the Zola binary: `brew install zola` (macOS), `snap install zola` (Linux), or download from https://www.getzola.org/documentation/getting-started/installation/
Run `npm install` (no-op — no Node deps; the package.json scripts are thin wrappers around the Zola CLI for tooling consistency).
Run `npm run serve` (or `zola serve --port 1111`) from the project root — Zola compiles templates + SASS and live-reloads at http://127.0.0.1:1111.
Edit `content/_index.md` to change the home page title and body copy; TOML frontmatter is delimited by `+++`.
Add blog posts as Markdown files in `content/posts/<slug>.md` — each needs `title`, `date`, and optionally `draft = true` in TOML frontmatter.
Run `zola build` to emit the production site to `public/` — no server required, deploy any static host.
gotchas: `templates/index.html` is required for the root section (`content/_index.md`); if it is missing or misnamed, Zola aborts with a template-not-found error.
SASS is compiled automatically from `sass/main.scss` into `public/main.css`; reference it in templates via `{{ get_url(path='main.css') }}`.

Content files do not render Tera by default — `{{ ... }}` in a Markdown body appears verbatim. The foundry substitutes `{{headline}}` / `{{subheadline}}` placeholders at compose time, before Zola ever sees the files.
Zola requires `base_url` in `config.toml` to be an absolute URL; leave it as `http://127.0.0.1:1111` for local dev and override for production.
Section pages (`_index.md`) cannot be drafts — the `draft = true` flag only works on leaf pages.
architectureNotes: Single Rust binary, zero Node.js / npm required. The only runtime dependency is the `zola` executable on PATH.
Standard layout: `config.toml` at root, content under `content/`, Tera templates under `templates/`, SASS under `sass/`, static assets under `static/`. Output lands in `public/`.
Tera inherits work via `{% extends "base.html" %}` — `templates/base.html` is scaffolded; extend it from new page templates to share `<head>`, nav, and footer without duplication.

placeholders.description: `{{headline}}` and `{{subheadline}}` are substituted by the foundry at compose time using the family defaults (`Starter Foundry Zola` / `Zola content site with built-in SASS pipeline.`). Replace them with real copy after scaffolding.
Minimal single-page template: title, subtitle, and a post list. Extract shared structure (head, nav, footer) into `templates/base.html` and `{% extends %}` from here once a second template is needed.
